checks.evidence: Exclusive watcher state prevents another default watcher. Every helper attempt exclusively retains REQUEST, RESULT, STDERR and LAUNCH PID; request/attempt state is written before Popen. Existing attempt paths cannot be replayed. Nonzero process, malformed/missing result, failed item or missing metadata halts without retry.
checks.name: once_only_and_unknown_outcome_guard

checks.evidence: Existing result-only batches can be adopted only when every ordered item succeeded with local metadata and exact checkpoint ACK Library/file/version identity plus archive SHA/length. Any existing request must match result order/path/purpose. The full receipt/ACK SHA binding is checked before uploads; adopted checkpoint sequences are excluded from pending uploads. next_batch advances above all prior batch numbers, currently to3.
checks.name: manual_batch_migration_without_duplicate_upload

checks.evidence: Only final .zip receipt filenames are considered; receipt path must be absolute within batch root and match receipt filename. local_archive_readback_verified must be true. Upload candidates must be regular non-symlink files with exact stored length and streamed SHA256. Archive CRC/readback verification was performed by the upstream checkpoint builder, not repeated by this watcher.
checks.name: archive_ready_and_hash_checks

checks.evidence: Receipts are sorted by unique positive sequence. Pending items preserve that order; each helper request contains at most20 files. Response count/order/path/purpose must match and each item must report succeeded plus local metadata and identity/version.
checks.name: ordered_bounded_helper_batches

checks.evidence: Current launch has no index identity and prior manual ACKs; the initial cumulative index is saved before any new archive batch. Later saves use replace_library_file with the same Library identity and expected_current_version. Replacement must preserve identity and advance version. A connected index xattr without explicit identity receipt blocks duplicate creation.
checks.name: one_cumulative_index_identity

checks.evidence: Existing recorder owns checkpoint ACK/index creation. Watcher requires successful recorder exit and an ACK for every uploaded sequence, then saves the cumulative index before closing the batch. File IDs/version and original receipt SHA remain recorded. No payload redownload is falsely claimed.
checks.name: separate_archive_ACK_and_index_save_closure

checks.evidence: Watcher reads scheduler status and checkpoint metadata and writes only transport/index files. It invokes Library helper and recorder only, with no scientific module imports or job/claim edits.
checks.name: numerical_state_is_untouched

checks.evidence: Only JSONDecodeError is reread for at most1second in pauses<=50milliseconds. The retry contains no helper invocation or Library mutation. A permanently invalid JSON still stops without replay.
checks.name: bounded_read_only_JSON_window_retry

checks.evidence: receipts_and_acks requires sequence exactly1..N before any initial index or archive upload. Gap fixture stops with zero archive/index upload requests.
checks.name: contiguous_checkpoint_receipt_prefix

nonblocking_constraints.finding: If reused in another workflow with an existing saved index identity and newly manual-ACKed archives, startup does not proactively resave that stale index until the next automatic archive batch.
nonblocking_constraints.impact: This does not apply to the current fresh-identity launch observed here.
nonblocking_constraints.operation: The current launch must remain the single owner after the manual batches; future migrations should compare the saved index hash before asserting cumulative remote completeness.

nonblocking_constraints.finding: An unexpected exception after helper launch may leave that helper alive while watcher stops.
nonblocking_constraints.impact: PID and attempt evidence are retained, and restart is blocked, preserving unknown outcome rather than duplicating the action.
nonblocking_constraints.operation: Reconcile the retained PID/request/result before any further transport action. Do not manually launch concurrent uploads or mutate the cumulative index while the watcher owns it.

resolved_review_findings: Final watcher now requires the contiguous checkpoint receipt prefix1..N.
Final watcher tolerates only the short read-only partial-JSON publication window, with no retry of any Library mutation.
